evidence.title: EviSafe: Evidence-Grounded Safety Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
SAVER: Selective Auditing of Verbal Evidence for Error Recovery in VLM Change Reasoning

summary: Researchers introduced EviSafe, a safety‑evaluation system that grounds its assessments in evidence extracted from vision‑language model outputs, and SAVER, a selective auditing approach that uses verbal evidence to recover from reasoning errors during VLM‑driven change tasks. Both methods aim to enhance the reliability and interpretability of VLMs by providing transparent, evidence‑based diagnostics.
title: New evidence‑grounded frameworks EviSafe and SAVER improve safety evaluation and error recovery in vision‑language models
